headline: Ukraine Strikes Russian Refineries as Halamish Gunman Remains at Large
subheadline: Russian missile-systems plant was hit in Kiev, while Ukrainian drones damaged Syzran refinery and halted Saratov operations amid widening drone alerts across Ukraine.
lede: Ukrainian drone attacks damaged the main processing unit at Russia’s Syzran refinery, reportedly operating at 71% capacity, and halted operations at Saratov refinery. They also struck Poltava region at Kobelyaki and Odesa region at Luzanivka amid a nationwide aerial threat, while a Russian strike targeted a Kiev enterprise producing missile control systems for Flamingo, Neptune, FP-7, and FP-9. In the West Bank, a Palestinian terrorist opened fire from a vehicle at a natural spring near Neve Tzuf (Halamish), seriously wounding an Israeli man in his 30s before fleeing on foot while armed. The IDF established a cordon and deployed special forces, drones, and Air Force aircraft to search the Halamish area, where troops located the attacker’s gun.

sections.title: Kiev Missile Enterprise and Russian Refineries Hit
sections.body: Russian forces struck a Kiev enterprise manufacturing missile control systems for Flamingo, Neptune, FP-7, and FP-9, targeting its data center and AFU network equipment operations. Ukrainian drone attacks damaged the Syzran refinery’s main processing unit, with repairs lasting more than a month, and stopped Saratov refinery operations. The reported Ukrainian strikes also hit Kobelyaki in Poltava region and Luzanivka in Odesa region amid nationwide aerial alerts. Russian advances continued in the Krasnolimansk direction through gray-zone territory, with pressure in Orekhovsk direction north of Orekhov.

sections.title: Halamish Attack Triggers Armed Manhunt in West Bank
sections.body: A Palestinian terrorist opened fire from a vehicle at a natural spring near Neve Tzuf (Halamish), seriously wounding an Israeli man in his 30s before fleeing on foot while armed. Magen David Adom took the injured man to Beilinson Hospital in serious condition. IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered additional troops to the Halamish area, established a cordon, and deployed special forces, drones, and Israeli Air Force aircraft to search for him. Gaza Strip strikes killed three Hamas terrorists involved in the October 7 invasion: Yahya Hamdouna, Mohammad Rafa'i, and Basir al-Barsh, a Nukhba Force commander.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Across both theaters, the day’s reporting shows attacks extending beyond front-line positions into critical industrial and military-support infrastructure: a Kiev missile-control enterprise and two Russian refineries. In the West Bank, an armed fugitive, a cordon, and a recovered weapon indicate a localized but intense security operation, while the killing of a Nukhba commander in Gaza confirms continued targeted strikes. Iranian rhetoric has escalated, and US officials have signaled possible military or economic actions regarding Iran’s nuclear program.
